CODE
Art. 2.3.36. 
Nullity as a sanction 
The family court may, at the request of one of the spouses showing a legitimate interest and without prejudice to the rights of bona fide third parties, annul the act performed by the other spouse: 
1¡ in breach of the provisions of articles 2.3.31, paragraph 2, 2.3.32 and 2.3.33; annulment of the acts listed in Article 2.3.32, 4¡ to 8¡, requires in addition the existence of an injury; 
2¡ in breach of a prohibition pronounced or conditions imposed by justice; 
3¡ in fraud of the rights of the plaintiff.
The burden of proving good faith lies with the third party.
